note: Hand-reviewed dot positions. Each moves a smelter or refinery from the point the source reports to the plant's published coordinates, after checking the spot on satellite imagery (Esri World Imagery, 13 November 2026) shows a smelter or works complex. `from` is the reported point; a move applies only while the facility still reports it.

duplicates.note: Records hidden because they repeat a plant the data already holds at the right spot. Hidden only while the record still carries this name. Nothing is deleted from facilities.geojson.
